notes.title: April 1st Special Update!
notes.content:
The April 1st update brings a new cool achievement! Hit some random guy's eggs on the roadside in "Episode 7: Ichi" and unlock this awesome achievement!

([i]Some minor text and translation fixes have also been applied.[/i])

[b]P.S.[/b]
Thank you to all the players — I love you so much! Thanks for leaving reviews, making videos, and helping to find bugs in the game and translations, as well as everyone who helped make these localizations happen! This April Fools' update is just a small joke, but it's not the last — I have ideas and plans to add a new ending! Thank you again for everything!

notes.title: A new episode celebrating the 2nd anniversary of Creepy Creepy Love!
notes.content:
On February 14, 2023, the original Creepy Creepy Love was released on Itch. We are grateful to all the players who have stayed with us since the game's original launch.

Additionally, Creepy Creepy Love is participating in the RPG Maker Festival, and from February 3, 2025, to February 10, 2025, the game will be available at a 30% discount!

The update adds:
[list]
[*] 
[*]     A new episode and a rival, Amy.
[*]     A scene with me after the credits.
[*]     5 new achievements.
[*]     The ability to skip the opening scene by pressing any button.
[*]     Music in the new game settings menu.
[/list]

Thank you for staying with us!

notes.title: Korean and Spanish translations are now available in Creepy Creepy Love!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880888/404f981d17dcff55e921bca77e8f7f58967628af.png[/img]
[i]Art by: galvanicAnimal[/i]

[b]Hello everyone![/b]
Creepy Creepy Love now supports two new languages: Spanish and Korean. This became possible thanks to the efforts of @HingHingman and @KokoroHatsaru. I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to them for supporting the game!

!!!"[i]The Korean translation was done using AI, so there might be inaccuracies, mistakes, or typos introduced when adding the text to the game. I’m open to fixing any errors, so if you find something, please let me know in the Steam community. This will greatly help me improve the game! I hope for your understanding and that you enjoy the game.[/i]"

A fast-forward feature has been added: now, by pressing U + SPACE or Y + B on the gamepad, text scrolls almost instantly.

Minor graphical and text errors have been fixed.

notes.title: Support Creepy Creepy Love at The Steam Awards.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880888/7a6672b0ded4db63b531659ddf85aa492ba29f08.jpg[/img]
[i]Art by: galvanicAnimal[/i]

[b]Hello everyone![/b]
We believe that a dramatic storyline supported by the visual style of 90s anime is the greatest strength of Creepy Creepy Love. We’ve poured our hearts into this little story and would be incredibly grateful if you support us in the “Best Game with Outstanding Story” category at The Steam Awards.

Thank you for staying with us, writing reviews, recording videos on YouTube, and creating fan art! We truly appreciate your attention.

In turn, we will continue to delight you with our quirky games and will also keep adding new content to Creepy Creepy Love.

notes.title: REBALANCE
notes.content:
The balance has been changed. Opponents have become weaker, timings between blows have been extended. Changes affected all opponents, especially Tsubaki.

It is now possible to change the difficulty after 3 defeats.

Fixed minor bugs and graphical artifacts.

P.S[i]
As always, I listened to the advice of players and released a patch based on their advice and preferences. I hope you will appreciate the new game balance![/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880888/0ea65745c1b0da3a7b1a20cc5d51fa56813db858.png[/img]

notes.title: I hooked up Steam Overlay!!!
notes.content: I hooked up Steam Overlay. Now you can take screenshots and see earned achievements!  (´ ∀ ` *)

notes.title: Added saves and other changes.
notes.content:
Many players have asked to add me saves to the game. In my opinion the game is too short for this feature, but nevertheless I made in game saves before each episode.

Also, menu sounds have been replaced in the game.

Fixed a bug in the Beat em up mode when Rosa took a lot of damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880888/fcbcfe9a82dcb22e1691eb95dc9730635dead3ef.png[/img]

notes.title: A small patch. (ง ื▿ ื)ว
notes.content:
In the training added paragraphs explaining the control and some features of the combat system:
[olist]

[*] [i]During the fight, try to use different blows. If you often attack your opponent with the same punch, he will start to block.[/i]

[*] [i]You can not only press the attack button, but also hold it down. In this case, the character will continue to attack until you release the button.[/i]
[/olist]
On easy difficulty in the Rose vs. Tsubaki fight, the rage scale is full from the start of the fight.

notes.title: Dialogue Rewind.
notes.content:
A hint has been added that shows you the button that quickly scrolls through dialogues.
You need to hold down the Space key or the A button on the controller to scroll through dialogs.
[i]
(The dialog scrolling feature was there before, but not all players understood how to use it and just pressed the action button many times. So I thought I'd add a hint).[/i]

Also fixed a number of graphical bugs, and bugs with achievements and previously was added and a new easy difficulty, which in this patch I finalized.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880888/80ce4ee220c912e630d696b15ffb793ed60f559e.png[/img]

notes.title: Bug fixes and new difficulty.
notes.content:
Fixed bugs, and added a new easy difficulty.

Thank you for playing my game.

If you find a bug, please let me know in the game community.

notes.title: Creepy Creepy Love is coming to Steam on October 7!
notes.content:
[b]The exact release date is October 7![/b] [i]Add the game to your wishlist! Tell your friends about the game. In the new version of Creepy Creepy Love we realized all our best ideas. It's a really creepy and dynamic story-driven fighting game. I'm looking forward to when the game comes out![/i]

[b]Thank you for supporting us![/b]

[i]BYYONI.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880888/398fd7164e261912d9b4081200f0f92d5b83a971.png[/img]

notes.title: Creepy Creepy Love
notes.content:
[b]A new demo is available! Play the demo and add the game to your wishlist.[/b]

Also subscribe to the channels of streamers who prepared this walkthrough especially for RPG MAKER HORROR FESTIVAL:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@PhuCat103]PhuCat103[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@catlover_mimi]つねこ / catlover_mimi[/url]

About the game:
[i]Dating simulator with yandere which at any moment can turn into a brutal love thriller. Every decision you make affects the development of the plot. Take responsibility for your actions, at least in a video game! It depends only on you whether Rose will be able to defeat all five evil rivals? Will Rose be able to be happy? And will she be together with Samon?! Make your decisions and come to one of three shocking endings.

One-on-one duels with MMA elements, punching and kicking, knocking your opponent to the ground and finishing him off in the parterre. Beat em up multiple opponents in Beat em up style, crush your enemies with the juicy sounds of punches and blood splatters in this arcade street fighting simulator! [/i]

notes.title: CCL - You can now do a demo review.
notes.content:
[b]You can now do reviews of the demo on Steam! [/b]
[i]Steam has a feature where you can leave a review for the demo. If you liked the game “Creepy Creepy Love” and want to support it, you can leave a review for the demo on Steam. The game will be released very soon and needs your feedback! [/i]


[b]Теперь вы можете делать обзоры демо-версии в Steam![/b]
[i]В Steam появилась функция, благодаря которой вы можете оставить обзор на демоверсию. Если вам понравилась игра “Creepy Creepy Love” и вы хотите поддержать её, то вы можете оставить обзор на демоверсию в Steam. Игра выйдет совсем скоро и нуждается в вашей обратной связи! [/i]

notes.title: !!! CCL - BUG FIXES !!!
notes.content:
[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[olist]
[*] The language selection buttons have changed to keyboard and gamepad arrows. (No more confusion with the Y button on the keyboard and gamepad.)
[*] Fixed character animation errors in the dialogs of the second episode.
[*] Fixed errors in the text where one and the same sentence was duplicated 2 times.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused enemies to sometimes attack you before the fight started.
[/olist]

[u]For a more enjoyable game experience, I recommend downloading the new version.[/u]

[b]ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ ОШИБОК[/b]
[olist]
[*] Кнопки выбора языка сменились на стрелки клавиатуры и геймпада. (Больше никакой путаницы с кнопкой Y на клавиатуре и геймпаде).
[*] Исправлены ошибки анимации персонажей в диалогах второго эпизода.
[*] Исправлены ошибки в тексте, когда одно и то же предложение дублировалось 2 раза.
[*] Исправлена ошибка, из-за которой враги иногда атаковали вас до начала боя.
[/olist]

[u]Для получения более приятного опыта игры, рекомендую скачать новую версию.[/u]
